gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a gross favourable development of GBP 8.7 million on prior accident year losses, representing a 6.78% release of its opening gross claims outstanding. This release was primarily driven by a GBP 2.6 million reduction in the estimated ultimate loss related to Storm Sandy, a GBP 3.5 million reduction from other large and small catastrophe events, and a GBP 2.6 million favourable development on attritional gross claims and claim expenses due to lower than expected reported claims activity. The syndicate's reserving methodology, including the Bornhuetter-Ferguson actuarial method for attritional losses and IBNR recalibration, contributed to these adjustments across property, casualty, and specialty reinsurance and insurance lines of business.
